text: Tamar's driving test is Friday at 3pm. Third attempt, she's properly nervous. Text her good luck that morning.
Luca got made redundant yesterday. Whole team gone. He's putting a brave face on it but his wife Chiara says he's not sleeping. Should take him for a pint next week.
jaya grad ceremony june 3rd 11am, her parents flying in from leicester
Chen passed!! Theory and practical both. Send congrats
Bilal's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Thursday at the mosque, half 1. I'm driving his cousin Ali there.
Note to self: dentist moved to the 12th at half 9. Also pick up dry cleaning before Saturday.

So Aidan and Alice have split up. Eight years. She's moved back in with her mum for now and he's keeping the flat and the dog, Biscuit. Don't take sides. Maybe check in with Alice at the weekend, she sounded really flat on the phone.
yuki audition for the conservatory nov 4 at 10am. cello. been practising 6 hrs a day
Chris's little one Matilda starts reception on Monday. He's more nervous than she is honestly
Results day for Jack is August 13th, 8am. Needs AAB for Durham. Remind me to message him that afternoon to see how it went.
Lin mentioned her dad's been diagnosed with Parkinson's. Early stage. She's going home to Taipei for three weeks from the 22nd.
Julia and her husband Pedro are both doing the London marathon in April. She's vegan, he's not, constant arguments about carb loading apparently.
Tobi: failed his driving test this morning, minor on roundabout + one serious for mirrors. rebooked for 5/14. gutted
Pooja's son Arjun graduates from Leeds on July 18 at 2pm. Gift idea — she said he's been eyeing a proper fountain pen.
Dinner at Kieran's Saturday got cancelled, his mum's in hospital again. Need to ring him tomorrow evening.
Teresa — retired nurse, lives next door to Heather, keeps chickens. Lovely. Grandson Paolo doing GCSEs this summer.
Heather's mum's funeral was yesterday. Went ok she said, but she's exhausted. Drop round some food this week, maybe Wednesday
Must email Aurelio about the reference letter before Friday 5pm, his PhD viva is the 28th
Kemal was let go after 14 years at the bank. Meeting with HR is Tuesday at 10. He wants me to look over his CV beforehand.
bumped into ryan at tesco. his daughter jada passed grade 5 piano with distinction. he was beaming
Mandla said his brother Tobi is taking the bar exam on Feb 24th and 25th. Family are all on edge.

Voice memo: okay so Katarzyna, Kasia, she's the one from the book club, her cat Pierogi died last week, she's devastated, had him eighteen years. Maybe send a card. Also she's doing her citizenship test on the 9th at 1pm I think.
Shira got into RADA!!! Starts September. Her mum cried on the phone apparently
Paolo's mock exams start Monday morning. Teresa says he's barely revised and spends all day on his Xbox
don't forget card for Chiara, her dad's anniversary (died 3 yrs ago) is oct 30
Chen and Lin are getting divorced. They've told the kids. Chen moving out end of the month, renting near the school so he can still do drop offs.
Just got off the phone with Alice. Her viva went well, minor corrections only! Celebration drinks Friday at 7, The Crown. I'm bringing prosecco.
Spoke to Bilal briefly, he's doing ok. Took two weeks off work. Prefers texts to calls right now.
Remind me: Jaya's sister Tamar has her nursing finals in May. Check the exact dates closer to the time.
Aidan's lad starts secondary next week, Tuesday. Big school, bus on his own for the first time. Aidan's a wreck lol
Luca had his interview at Rolls-Royce this morning at 9. Thinks it went alright. Hears back by Thursday. Text him Thursday evening if he hasn't said anything.

Long call with Julia tonight. Her nan passed in the night, peacefully, care home in Galway. Funeral likely Monday or Tuesday, Julia's flying over Saturday morning with her brother Kieran. She's worried about leaving the kids, Pedro's got work. I offered to do the school run Monday and Tuesday. Should send flowers to the family too, ask her for the address.
Yuki's youngest had his first swimming badge today. 10 metres! Proud mum vibes all over the group chat
Tobi said Pooja's been struggling since the breakup. Not eating much. Might invite her over for dinner next week.
Gym, then pharmacy, then the post office. Parcel for mum needs to go by Thursday.
Arjun's eleven plus is September 14th, 9:15 start. Pooja's paying for a tutor two evenings a week.
Matilda lost her first tooth! Chris says the tooth fairy rate is now a pound, outrageous
Heather and her partner Ali are moving to Bristol in the new year. She got the deputy head job there, starts January 6th.
kemal update: got a new job!! starts 1st dec at an insurance firm in leeds. relieved isn't the word
Need to book my own driving lesson for next Wednesday at 4. And check when my theory certificate runs out.
Jack's girlfriend dumped him over text two days before his finals. Rough. He's sitting the first one Tuesday at 9:30. Message him Monday night, just keep it light.
Aurelio — Italian, plays mandolin, allergic to shellfish. Wife is Chiara (the other Chiara, not Luca's).
Ryan's dad has his hearing test on March 3rd at 2:40. Ryan's taking him because he refuses to go alone.
Mrs Hughes from across the road lost her husband. Funeral is the 19th, 11am at St Mary's. I'll go.
Mandla is gutted, didn't get the part in the Sondheim thing. Second audition this year. He'll bounce back but maybe take him for lunch
Jada graduates from nursery Friday afternoon, little gowns and hats and everything. Ryan sent a pic of the rehearsal
Shira's grandma has been in and out of hospital. She's really anxious. Ask after her next time I see her.
Teresa's birthday is 4/22. Loves gardening, mentioned wanting a new pair of secateurs

Okay so Pedro just texted, his redundancy consultation is tomorrow morning at 10:30, then a second one next Friday. He's fairly sure he's on the list. Julia doesn't know yet. Ring him tomorrow after lunch.
Kasia's daughter got her A-level results this morning, straight As, off to Edinburgh to do medicine
Chris and his ex Jada finally sorted custody. Matilda's with him weekends. Happier than I've seen him in months
Mental note — Lin's exam board results come out on the 15th of next month. Ask her how she got on.
Bilal Ahmed's PhD graduation July 9 at 10am, Great Hall. Ali's driving us. Don't forget to get him something small, maybe a framed photo.
Katarzyna Petrov (Kasia) called — her son Luca passed his driving test first time, 2 minors. Already asking for the car keys.
Rainy day, nothing much. Finished the jigsaw.
Arjun's school play is next Thursday at 6pm. He's a tree. Pooja made the costume out of a green bin bag and cardboard.
Tamar MacDonald, Jaya's flatmate, also training as a midwife. Huge Spurs fan.
Aidan's sister Shira had her twins last night!! Both healthy. Send congrats and maybe organise a meal train for when they're home
Uncle Paolo's memorial service got pushed to Sunday afternoon. Need to tell Heather and Kieran.

Yuki said her brother Kemal got made redundant from the studio last month, and then his girlfriend left him the week after. He's staying on her sofa for now and she's worried about him, says he hasn't really left the house since. Also, her own driving test is finally booked for June 12th at 8:10am, which she's dreading. Should check in on her next week and maybe send Kemal that job listing I saw.
